summary: Fremont National Forest lookout cab in Lake County, Oregon, built in 1931 and gone by 1950; an emergency lookout by the Dairy Creek Guard Station; registered 2011.

events.note: Cab built on the site (register: 'Built in 1931, this cab'; firelookout.com: '1931: cab')
Registered May 20, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1931 for the cab; the Lake County list gives 'the 1930s' with unknown structures. These agree at a coarser level; the story uses 1931 from the register and says the Lake County list dates the site to the 1930s.

notes_for_editor: Ground-level site: the register and firelookout.com describe a cab only, with no tower. The Lake County list gives an emergency-lookout role and 'Removed: ? Gone' with no date; the story does not claim a removal year beyond 'gone by 1950'. No staffing names or fires were found in the sources read. The register page credits photos (1933 panorama, 2005 site photo) by caption only; no image URLs were captured, so no photo records were added. Brief record (FFLOS US 1016, 2011 registration, Lake County, Fremont National Forest) matched the sources; no corrections.
